INSERT INTO theme.mkt_tenancy (tenancy_id, contract_num, tawtheeq_unit_id, tawtheeq_property_id, gisid, tenancy_status, unit_status, start_date, tenancy_end_date, termination_date, rental_value_aed, unit_name, unit_type, unit_usage, unit_area_sqm, bedrooms, property_name, property_type, property_usage, actual_usage, year_built, plot_number, src_district, src_community) VALUES
(#{r.tenancyId}, #{r.contractNum}, #{r.tawtheeqUnitId}, #{r.tawtheeqPropertyId}, #{r.gisid}, #{r.tenancyStatus}, #{r.unitStatus}, #{r.startDate}, #{r.tenancyEndDate}, #{r.terminationDate}, #{r.rentalValueAed}, #{r.unitName}, #{r.unitType}, #{r.unitUsage}, #{r.unitAreaSqm}, #{r.bedrooms}, #{r.propertyName}, #{r.propertyType}, #{r.propertyUsage}, #{r.actualUsage}, #{r.yearBuilt}, #{r.plotNumber}, #{r.srcDistrict}, #{r.srcCommunity})

INSERT INTO theme.mkt_sale (sale_application_id, contract_date, sale_type, price_aed, normalized_price_aed, sold_area_sqm, rate_aed_sqm, src_municipality, src_district, src_community, land_plot, building_id, unit_floor, property_category, property_type, property_layout, project_name, developer_name, geom) VALUES
(#{r.saleApplicationId}, #{r.contractDate}, #{r.saleType}, #{r.priceAed}, #{r.normalizedPriceAed}, #{r.soldAreaSqm}, #{r.rateAedSqm}, #{r.srcMunicipality}, #{r.srcDistrict}, #{r.srcCommunity}, #{r.landPlot}, #{r.buildingId}, #{r.unitFloor}, #{r.propertyCategory}, #{r.propertyType}, #{r.propertyLayout}, #{r.projectName}, #{r.developerName}, )
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO theme.mkt_mortgage (contract_id, start_date, end_date, amount_aed, general_category, contract_type, contract_status, property_type, src_municipality, src_district, src_community, land_plot, building_id, geom) VALUES
(#{r.contractId}, #{r.startDate}, #{r.endDate}, #{r.amountAed}, #{r.generalCategory}, #{r.contractType}, #{r.contractStatus}, #{r.propertyType}, #{r.srcMunicipality}, #{r.srcDistrict}, #{r.srcCommunity}, #{r.landPlot}, #{r.buildingId}, )
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO theme.mkt_rent (contract_number, start_date, end_date, annual_value_aed, total_value_aed, rented_area_sqm, application_type, contract_status, asset_class, property_type, project_name, developer_name, src_municipality, src_district, src_community, land_plot, building_id, geom) VALUES
(#{r.contractNumber}, #{r.startDate}, #{r.endDate}, #{r.annualValueAed}, #{r.totalValueAed}, #{r.rentedAreaSqm}, #{r.applicationType}, #{r.contractStatus}, #{r.assetClass}, #{r.propertyType}, #{r.projectName}, #{r.developerName}, #{r.srcMunicipality}, #{r.srcDistrict}, #{r.srcCommunity}, #{r.landPlot}, #{r.buildingId}, )
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO theme.mkt_plot_transaction (kind, txn_id, elms_plot_id, amount_aed, txn_date, project_name) VALUES
(#{r.kind}, #{r.txnId}, #{r.elmsPlotId}, #{r.amountAed}, #{r.txnDate}, #{r.projectName})
mapper.update: UPDATE theme.mkt_tenancy t SET plot_key = p.plot_key, community_key = p.community_key, district_key = p.district_key, municipality_code = p.municipality_code FROM theme.sp_plot p WHERE t.gisid IS NOT NULL AND p.gisid = t.gisid

UPDATE theme.${table} x SET plot_key = p.plot_key, community_key = p.community_key, district_key = p.district_key, municipality_code = p.municipality_code FROM theme.sp_plot p WHERE x.geom IS NOT NULL AND p.cancel_date IS NULL AND p.geom && x.geom AND ST_Intersects(p.geom, x.geom); UPDATE theme.${table} x SET community_key = c.community_key, district_key = c.district_key, municipality_code = c.municipality_code FROM theme.sp_community c WHERE x.community_key IS NULL AND x.geom IS NOT NULL AND c.geom && x.geom AND ST_Intersects(c.geom, x.geom); UPDATE theme.${table} x SET building_key = b.building_key FROM theme.sp_building b WHERE x.geom IS NOT NULL AND b.geom && x.geom AND ST_Intersects(b.geom, x.geom)

UPDATE theme.mkt_plot_transaction x SET plot_key = p.plot_key, community_key = p.community_key, district_key = p.district_key, municipality_code = p.municipality_code FROM theme.sp_plot p WHERE x.elms_plot_id IS NOT NULL AND p.elms_plot_id = x.elms_plot_id
